requirements.heading: Other Header Fields
requirements.text: If the software understands the header field's structure and a downgrading algorithm other than Unstructured is applicable, that software SHOULD use that algorithm; Unstructured downgrading is used when there is no other option.

requirements.heading: Security Considerations
requirements.text: The downgrade mechanism SHOULD NOT remove signatures even if the signatures will fail validation after downgrading.

requirements.heading: Security Considerations
requirements.text: As much of the information as possible from the original message SHOULD be preserved.

requirements.heading: Implementation Note: Encoded-Word Encoding
requirements.text: While RFC 5322 states that implementations SHOULD limit lines to 78 characters or less, implementations MAY choose to allow overly long encoded words to work around faulty implementations of encoded-words.

requirements.heading: Implementation Note: Encoded-Word Encoding
requirements.text: Implementations that choose to do so SHOULD have an optional mechanism to limit line length to 78 characters.
